name: Starburst Original Fruit Chews
whyItWorks: Soft, chewy fruit-flavored squares made with corn syrup, sugar, and fruit juice. They are naturally gluten-free, fat-free, and contain 0g fiber, breaking down cleanly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Unwrap and chew thoroughly. A great portable sweet for pockets or backpacks.
watchOuts: High in sugar; eat in moderation.
